case.summary: Following an analyst request to review transaction 3478561 ($74.96 online) and related activity on card C13487-K1, the investigation evaluated the customer's transaction history, device profile, and graph centrality metrics. Although the flagged online transaction used device profile D-1c4e293f579b, analysis determined this fingerprint is non-diagnostic because it is shared across 52 customers, and network graph centrality scores remained near average. The case memory retrieval yielded three confirmed fraud cases, but the low risk score (0.05) and lack of a card-testing pattern or confirmed customer denial rendered the single online purchase ambiguous. Consequently, following standard card-not-present guidelines, the recommended action is to verify the transaction with the customer (`VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER`).
